<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 0"
    pfs=""
>
[Bracers of Missile Deflection](/Equipment.aspx?ID=417)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 607 <sup>4.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn bracers

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These bracers are made from plates of durable mithral and gleam like the summer sun.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** A ranged weapon attack hits you but doesn’t critically hit; **Requirements** You are aware of the attack and not flat-footed; **Effect** The bracers send the missile off-course. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If this would cause the attack to be a failure, the attack misses you.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Bracers of Missile Deflection
